seeds.asked: Describe the fixture concept used to prove the scripts/asu toolchain builds and validates.
seeds.label: A fixture concept proves the toolchain mints and validates before real content is authored.
seeds.definition: A fixture concept is a throwaway record used only to prove the scripts/asu toolchain builds valid batches, mints IDs correctly, and produces byte-identical rebuilds.
seeds.objective: State what a fixture concept in this toolchain is used to prove.
seeds.pitfall: Mistaking a fixture record for real authored Ain Shams content — it must never land in docs/Ain-Shams-Source-Imports.
